test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1. I visited a zoo last weekend.

P: The lions were resting under trees.

Q: I saw many wild animals there.

R: Monkeys were swinging on branches.

S: The elephants were eating sugarcane.

6. It was a fun and learning experience.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence begins with “I visited a zoo last weekend.” This sets the context of the paragraph — a personal experience at the zoo.
 
• After this introduction, the logical continuation is to describe what the person **saw** at the zoo. Hence, **Q: I saw many wild animals there** comes next.
 
• Once animals are mentioned in general, the description of specific animals follows in a natural order — **S (elephants), P (lions), and R (monkeys)**.
 
• Finally, the concluding sentence “It was a fun and learning experience.” sums up the visit, giving closure to the paragraph.

Therefore, the correct sequence is **QSPR**.

 

**Coherent Paragraph After Rearrangement:**

*1. I visited a zoo last weekend. Q. I saw many wild animals there. S. The elephants were eating sugarcane. P. The lions were resting under trees. R. Monkeys were swinging on branches. 6. It was a fun and learning experience.*
